items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Tommy Dorsey gave one of his arrangements to a band in Philadelphia... Tommy said, 'oh I want that arrangement'. So they traded arrangements.

ctx.x: No I don't indeed. I think 'I Can't Get Started With You' was the only big single he made wasn't it?

That arrangement, it reminds me of the arranging. Now Tommy Dorsey gave one of his arrangements to a band in Philadelphia that was sharing a stage show with him or something like that. A black band in Philadelphia played their arrangement of 'Marie' which was his arrangement that we know of so well. So Tommy said, 'oh I want that arrangement'. So they traded arrangements. You know they gave him one of his and they gave him one of theirs.
